 if(editGrade==='mono'){ctx.fillStyle='#111e21';ctx.globalCompositeOperation='saturation';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over'}
 ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.restore();}

 if(editTransition==='dissolve'&&frame.local<.75&&frame.index>0){const prev=editSequence[frame.index-1];ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,1-frame.local/.75)*.8;editPaintImage(prev.id,prev.length);ctx.restore()}

// V5 · The Living Scene. Historical framing is explicitly separated from original creative exercises.
const living={beat:0,zoom:24,tone:'dusk',sound:'quiet',playing:false,ctx:null,master:null,nodes:[],anim:0,t:0};
const livingBeats=[
 {eyebrow:'01 / 03 · THE FIELD',title:'A world still waiting.',subtitle:'Before the train, there is a field, two figures and the mystery of what lies beyond it.',note:'The scene first asks us to notice an environment. Holding space in the frame can make the characters feel small in a much larger world.'},
 {eyebrow:'02 / 03 · THE DISTANCE',title:'Something is coming.',subtitle:'A distant presence can exist in the imagination before we understand what it is.',note:'A long view and an approaching sound may produce anticipation without immediately revealing a source.'},
 {eyebrow:'03 / 03 · DISCOVERY',title:'The world opens.',subtitle:'The extraordinary can emerge from something seemingly ordinary.',note:'A tighter image makes a subject more prominent. The viewer has less environmental information, but more immediate direction for attention.'}
];

const livingArt=document.getElementById('livingArt');
let livingRaf=0,livingLast=0;
function livingPaint(){
 const B=livingBeats[living.beat];
 document.getElementById('livingShotNumber').textContent=B.eyebrow;
 document.getElementById('livingSceneTitle').textContent=B.title;
 document.getElementById('livingSceneSubtitle').textContent=B.subtitle;
 document.getElementById('livingBeatMarker').textContent=`BEAT 0${living.beat+1} / 03`;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-beat-pick]').forEach(b=>{const yes=Number(b.dataset.beatPick)===living.beat;b.classList.toggle('selected',yes);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(yes))});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-scene-beat]').forEach(b=>{const yes=Number(b.dataset.sceneBeat)===living.beat;b.classList.toggle('selected',yes);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(yes))});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-tone]').forEach(b=>{let yes=b.dataset.tone===living.tone;b.classList.toggle('selected',yes);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(yes))});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-soundscape]').forEach(b=>{const yes=b.dataset.soundscape===living.sound;b.classList.toggle('selected',yes);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(yes))});
 document.getElementById('livingDistance').value=living.zoom;
 document.getElementById('livingDistanceValue').textContent=living.zoom+'%';
 const beatZoom=[0,.035,.07][living.beat];
 livingFrame.style.setProperty('--look-scale',(1.05+living.zoom*.0055+beatZoom).toFixed(3));
 const looks={dusk:'brightness(.93) saturate(.91) contrast(1.03)',gold:'brightness(1.15) sepia(.21) saturate(1.28)',mono:'grayscale(1) contrast(1.15) brightness(.98)'};
 livingFrame.style.setProperty('--look-filter',looks[living.tone]);
 document.getElementById('livingGrade').style.background=living.tone==='gold'?'linear-gradient(120deg,#bd8f4870,transparent 65%,#f6bb6170)':living.tone==='mono'?'linear-gradient(120deg,#3340417a,transparent 65%,#aaa8a44d)':'linear-gradient(120deg,#031a2b77,transparent 65%,#9d845c44)';
 const framing=living.zoom>65?'Your close framing prioritizes a specific gesture or shape. It can create intimacy, but obscures more of the surrounding geography.':living.zoom>34?'The medium-distance framing balances subject and environment, so attention and context can coexist.':'The wide view leaves room for anticipation. The empty space may be as meaningful as the subject.';
 document.getElementById('livingLessonText').textContent=B.note+' '+framing;
}
function livingUpdateBeat(v){living.beat=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,Number(v)));livingPaint()}
function livingUpdateZoom(v){living.zoom=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(v)));livingPaint()}

function livingDraw(now){livingRaf=0;if(!state.entered||state.view!=='scene'||!state.motion)return;
 const c=document.getElementById('livingParticles'),r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.width===0||r.height===0)return;
 const d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.5),W=Math.round(r.width*d),H=Math.round(r.height*d);
 if(c.width!==W||c.height!==H){c.width=W;c.height=H}
 const x=c.getContext('2d');x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const t=now/1000;
 for(let j=0;j<65;j++){const px=((j*117.13+Math.sin(t*.21+j)*12+W*3)%W),py=((j*79.73+(t*(1+j%3)*1.4))%H),rr=.55+j%3*.24; x.beginPath();x.fillStyle=`rgba(247,215,166,${.05+(j%7)*.011})`;x.ellipse(px,py,rr*d,rr*d,0,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill()}
 const wind=living.beat===1?1.5:1;
 x.lineWidth=Math.max(.5,1.1*d);for(let j=0;j<52;j++){let px=(j*.6180339%1)*W,base=H*(.81+(j%13)/70),h=(16+j%17*2)*d;
 let sway=Math.sin(t*.9*wind+j*.64)*7*d;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(px,base);x.quadraticCurveTo(px+sway*.5,base-h*.35,px+sway,base-h);x.strokeStyle=`rgba(198,177,127,${.05+(j%5)*.017})`;x.stroke()}
 livingRaf=requestAnimationFrame(livingDraw)
}

function livingSoundStop(){const c=living.ctx;living.ctx=null;living.playing=false;document.getElementById('livingListen').textContent='▶   Play imagined soundscape';document.getElementById('livingListen').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');if(!c)return;try{if(living.master)living.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,c.currentTime,.025);setTimeout(()=>c.close().catch(()=>{}),150)}catch{}}
function livingSoundStart(){livingSoundStop();if(living.sound==='quiet'){toast('Silence is part of this composition');return}
 try{let AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)throw Error('unsupported');let c=new AC();living.ctx=c;
  let master=c.createGain();master.gain.value=.0;master.gain.setTargetAtTime(.095,c.currentTime,.2);master.connect(c.destination);living.master=master;
  let length=Math.round(c.sampleRate*2),buffer=c.createBuffer(1,length,c.sampleRate),data=buffer.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<length;i++){let z=(Math.sin(i*.013)*.24+Math.sin(i*.007)*.17);data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*.38+z*.13}
  const source=c.createBufferSource();source.buffer=buffer;source.loop=true;const filter=c.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=living.sound==='field'?480:175;const g=c.createGain();g.gain.value=living.sound==='field'?.8:.34;source.connect(filter);filter.connect(g);g.connect(master);source.start();
  if(living.sound==='approach'){for(const [freq,type,volume] of [[67,'sine',.24],[114,'triangle',.09]]){const o=c.createOscillator(),gain=c.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,c.currentTime);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq*1.2,c.currentTime+8);gain.gain.value=volume;o.connect(gain);gain.connect(master);o.start()}}
  living.playing=true;const button=document.getElementById('livingListen');button.textContent='Ⅱ   Stop soundscape';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
 }catch(e){livingSoundStop();toast('Audio is unavailable in this browser')}
}

 const a=document.createElement('a');a.download='ORIGIN-v5-original-scene-study.png';a.href=C.toDataURL('image/png');document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();toast('Frame captured as PNG')};img.onerror=()=>toast('Image not loaded; try again');img.src='data:image/webp;base64,
